results.title: L'Homme de Fer-Blanc
results.overview: Etienne narrowly earns a living by being a street performer, namely a living statue. Moved to action by his landlord's ultimatum, he must do various jobs during the day to make the rent, but his efforts are unfruitful. Having met a dead end, Etienne has no choice but to accept his fate.

results.title: Durazno
results.overview: First part of "La trilogía de las frutas" and the first short film belonging to the "Manifiesto Helsinki" film movement.

results.title: Horseheads
results.overview: Horseheads is a comedy/crime short film that takes a wild spin on the classic buddy story. It follows Billy, a clueless young drifter searching for meaning, and Frank, a washed-up crook long past his prime. When Billy’s genius plan to rob the local chinese burger joint goes hilariously sideways, the duo stumbles into an unexpected journey of botched heists, unlikely friendship, and maybe figuring out what the heck they’re doing with their lives.

results.title: Relentless Fury
results.overview: Captain Lin Lang leads "Shadow", an elite 4-man mercenary team famed for flawless missions and zero casualties. When their broker delivers a bullet-sealed letter (an unrefusable contract), a deadly game begins...

results.title: The Last Supper
results.overview: In the days leading to betrayal, a gathering of disciples unravels into a web of secrets and hidden motives. As tensions simmer beneath the surface, trust is tested, and loyalty is questioned. The Last Supper becomes a night where nothing is as it seems, and every glance hides a deeper truth.

results.title: Clementine
results.overview: Over the 24 hours before a custody hearing, Clementine and her mom Sophie go on their own emotional journeys.

results.title: The Last GunFight
results.overview: ​In a ruthless underground tournament, the world's top assassins fight to the death. But hidden among them is a rogue crew with its own deadly agenda: infiltrate the competition, survive the bloodbath, and take down the mastermind pulling the strings.

results.title: Atlantaquaria
results.overview: Filmed at the Atlantaquarium in Galway, Ireland

results.title: The Inspector
results.overview: A fake gas inspector visits vulnerable elderly people to take advantage of them. It is now the turn of Carmen, a charming grandmother who keeps great antiques.

results.title: The Birdwatcher
results.overview: Investigators approach a bird watching hut deep in the forest following the disappearance of a grieving man. As they piece together his final moments, the evidence they gather becomes increasingly unnerving and hard to explain.

results.title: Senior Prank
results.overview: When their senior prank goes wildly off the rails, four students scramble to fix the mess, dodge authority, and survive the most chaotic day of their high school lives.

results.title: Daddy, Komplex
results.overview: On a ferry in Greece, the co-dependent German-Greek sisters PINA (24) and OLA (28) set sail on a sisterly holiday, destined for adventure. When their inseparable bond is truly tested by their “father complex”, all is to play for.

results.title: Smoking Mirrors
results.overview: As police investigate a mysterious figure known as Fingers, a web of secrets and lies makes it difficult to tell who is guilty or innocent.

results.title: Red Light
results.overview: Two strangers regain consciousness in a dimly lit room, disoriented and unable to remember how they got there. With no way out and no clue who has confined them, they are forced to rely on each other for survival. As fear and uncertainty mount, a tense bond forms between them—one that blurs the lines between trust, desire, and control. The confined space becomes both refuge and prison as emotions intensify and reality begins to distort. When an ominous red light suddenly flickers on, the truth behind their captivity—and the fragile nature of their connection—is finally revealed.

results.title: October Rhapsody
results.overview: K has cancer and tries to find a man for Cream because she is very afraid of being left alone. K must find a partner for Cream. Meanwhile, he must struggle in his life that is getting thinner. If he fails, then Cream will live a life of solitude.

results.title: Secret Magic Control Agency II: Mission Sleeping Beauty
results.overview: Agents Hansel and Gretel undergo their most important mission yet. In a race against the clock, the agents must work together to save a princess from her enchanted slumber. But when they cross paths with a sorcery-wielding Prince who is after the same prize, Gretel finds herself battling the most powerful force she's ever experienced... true love.

results.title: A Primavera
results.overview: In a decadent and melancholic metropolis, the poet Jeová seeks inspiration and recognition. His life begins to change after a mysterious figure starts buying his poems, and he meets Maria, a prostitute. Having to face their ghosts and desires, in a society where everything is calculated by money, these marginalized characters embark on a journey of poetic and delirious self-discovery.

results.title: Black Showman
results.original_title: ブラック・ショーマン
results.overview: Fukuyama plays the extremely unique protagonist Kamio Takeshi, who has outstanding magic that has made him famous in Las Vegas and a skillful ability to observe people, but is also strict with money and lies as easily as he breathes.  Furthermore, Kamio Mayo, the niece of Kamio Takeshi played by Fukuyama, who teams up with Takeshi after her father is killed by someone and works hard to solve the murder case, will be played by top actress Arimura Kasumi, who has brilliantly played a variety of roles from love stories to comedies and period dramas, and whose solid acting skills have captivated people!
